paragraphs: Rabbi Yaakov bar Korshai: Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat, chapter 10, halakhah 8; Horayot 13b has ben Korshi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman gives Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 10:8 and the forms Korshai/Korshi. The saved Guggenheimer paragraph marked halakhah 5 in chapter 10 writes Yaakov bar Kodshai (קודשי); the William Davidson digital text of Horayot 13b writes Yaakov ben Kudshai (קדשי). The supplied names and locator are retained alongside these witness differences.

The actual Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat paragraph marked halakhah 5 in chapter 10 and Davidson Horayot 13b locally support the full Rabbi title for Yaakov, but their Kodshai/Kudshai spellings remain distinct from Hyman’s Korshai/Korshi. His chapter 10 halakhah 8 locator and the current note are retained; this is no printed-edition comparison, Hebrew repair, or identity harmonization.
